label_safe_zones.description: Reserve readable zones for section labels, area names, axes, room names, server names, route labels, or timeline labels before placing interactive objects.
rules: Labels define spatial meaning and must not be covered by cards, glows, badges, or objects.
Objects should snap around label zones or labels should move to protected layers.
If a label is intentionally secondary, fade it deliberately but keep it legible enough to orient the user.
Use collision detection or layout constraints when objects are draggable or dynamic.
rejected: labels clipped by viewport or scroll container

primary_object_map.description: When a map, floor plan, seating chart, or timeline is the product object, it should own the command surface.
rules: Use panels as inspectors, filters, queues, or action surfaces.
Do not reduce the product object to one generic card among many.
Provide clear selected state between object and inspector.

placebo_navigation_guard.description: Navigation/tabs over spatial products must change visible content, object scope, mode, route, filter, or selected panel.
rules: Active nav state must correspond to visible product state.
If a tab is not implemented, disable it or remove it.
If a tab is a filter, the filtered result must visibly change.
Do not leave the same map and inspector visible while only changing selected styling.
